kiki.role.about: Play a part and talk in English together. On your turn, tap the mic button and say your line (shown in Japanese) in English.
kiki.role.private: Your voice is heard only on this iPhone. Your partner gets only a ✓ for each phrase you said.
kiki.role.needTwo: This one is for two. You can start once your partner joins
kiki.role.alone: Your partner is away, so you say this line too
kiki.role.heard: What came through (only you see this)
kiki.role.miss.none: No voice came through. Move closer to the mic and try again
kiki.role.miss.denied: The mic isn't allowed. Allow it in the iPhone's Settings › Safari › Microphone
kiki.role.miss.capped: The server's speech recognition is done for today. Carry on without the mic
kiki.role.miss.other: That didn't come through. Try again
kiki.role.unavailable: Speech recognition isn't available. Say it out loud, then go on without the mic
kiki.role.listen: Listen to your partner's English. Can you hear the key phrases?
kiki.role.quiet: Did you say it out loud?
kiki.role.rowNote: Only the time is kept. Nothing you said is saved
kiki.role.host.some: Nice conversation! Have a listen to the villagers' version
kiki.role.host.few: Talking is the best practice. Hear the villagers' version and try again
kiki.role.join.title: This uses the mic
kiki.role.join.body: In role-play you speak on your turn. Your voice is never sent to your partner's phone.
kiki.role.join.offBody: This game uses the mic. Turn it on in ききみみ's settings › Mic to join.
